mentions.name: RDX
mentions.description: RDX is a replicated data exchange format implemented as a JSON superset that supports diffs, patches, branches, and merges at the data-format level, making replicated data workflows straightforward.
mentions.source_excerpt: Replicated Data exchange format, RDX. A JSON superset that has diff, patches, branches and merges. Once you have that ability at the data format level, many things become surprisingly straightforward.
